scope: App-owned lifecycles in handwritten Rust, Swift and TypeScript, plus retained Windows adapters and supporting website/release tools. Conceptual states/events summarize actual code; they are not new wire values or a claim about dependency internals.

machines.encoding: exclusive overview/practice-page/settings visibility and labeled current-page navigation
machines.invariant: Only visible focused Practice grants a context; leaving revokes and clears ephemeral input/text. Overview never grants practice context; native own-app refusal independently prevents external fallback. Setup guide and tray Practice select the Practice page.

machines.encoding: persisted Appearance enum system/light/dark; independent pending selection and snapshot revision; native main-thread NSApplication override
machines.invariant: Presentation only: never cancels capture or changes practice/usage. Root attribute observes saved/reconciled status; pending/stale polls and duplicate changes cannot overwrite selection. Native dispatch holds no Rust state lock. System removes the app override and follows future OS changes. Other Store fields survive migration and writes.

machines.encoding: ephemeral paused, excluded bundle set, physical latches and bounded monotonic PID/bundle receipt tickets; Store persists exclusions only
machines.invariant: Pause blocks new global starts, exclusions only new external starts. Receipt rejection cannot rearm before release. Unknown/own/changed external identity fails before engine construction. Explicit practice remains available. Settings never cancel admitted or cue-waiting work; no Rust state lock crosses native dispatch.

machines.encoding: actual SMAppService.mainApp status plus operation error; injectable effects
machines.invariant: OS authoritative on main thread, no persisted competing boolean or automatic registration. Approval-required is not enabled; errors retain actual observed status. Normal launch presentation unchanged.

machines.encoding: Store optional stable UID; frozen per-recording UID, resolved device and engine-local binding
machines.invariant: Listing never creates an engine or prompts. Persist only UID; unavailable saved choices never silently fall back. Bind before format/converter; revalidate before and after engine start. Capsule/practice observe existing Session sample count and frozen limit, never wall time or another recorder.

machines.encoding: monotonic revision, optional eligible context and physical hold receipt map
machines.invariant: Late grants cannot revive an old view; held input retains receipt context; dashboard ineligibility cannot fall through to external capture. Context is not native authorization.

machines.encoding: preparing revision, physical source/token identity, native admission receipt and released latch
machines.invariant: Only the owning physical release finishes; early release survives pending clear/start; reset cannot rearm late work. Physical identity is not a recording token. Shortcut starts forward a valid native receipt; missing receipts never become explicit button starts.

machines.encoding: actual WorkflowStatus, independent pending owners and snapshot revision; coalesced status promise
machines.invariant: Stale status never overwrites edits; independent replies merge only their own field. Approval is not enabled. Unknown/non-Mac/installer actions fail closed. Absent saved IDs remain visible and app names are text only. Metadata enumeration is explicit, never periodic. UI eligibility never grants native authority.

machines.encoding: Status.phase, Inner.generation/session_epoch/practice, Control FIFO
machines.invariant: Only matching generation and cancellation epoch may publish; practice destination is immutable.

machines.encoding: Monotonic atomic epoch
machines.invariant: A queued start, stale completion or return to prior focus cannot revive a revoked ticket.

machines.encoding: Per-Key cancelled/generation/released/finished plus closed generation
machines.invariant: Release identifies the actual accepted generation, including release-before-start; worker teardown retires ownership.

machines.encoding: pressed timestamp, blocked, receipt epoch
machines.invariant: Only an isolated short release toggles once; repeats never replace receipt epoch.

machines.encoding: Option<Arc<Session>> keyed by generation and epoch
machines.invariant: Cancellation does not free the slot before worker teardown.

machines.encoding: audio deque, done/error/limit_reported, atomic cancelled, Condvar
machines.invariant: Bounded samples; one limit event; cancellation clears queued audio; capture failure defeats partial success.

machines.encoding: Segmenter pending/quiet/frame, optional context and one-shot loader
machines.invariant: No overlap or forced cuts, one context load, serial inference, final cancellation/failure proof.

machines.encoding: latest/active token, epoch, generation, phase and ephemeral text; recording-only meter identity
machines.invariant: Revocation tombstones late starts; stale generations cannot publish; no clipboard or usage route. Meter snapshots are rechecked after lock-free native dispatch.

machines.encoding: downloading phase/progress, partial model file and final hash/size
machines.invariant: Only a fully verified model becomes ready; failed partial output is removed; no concurrent recording/install.

machines.encoding: Control::Configure FIFO, old/new Store snapshots, native apply and rollback
machines.invariant: Saved/live settings stay aligned; invalidate old gestures; no Inner lock across native owner calls where required.

machines.encoding: Store defaults/validation, temporary write, sync, atomic replacement, error
machines.invariant: No half-written destination; explicit error; preference transactions publish after save, delivered usage reports persistence failure separately.

machines.encoding: permission bits, model_ready, hotkey, PERMISSION_REQUESTS and setup phase
machines.invariant: Checking never prompts; explicit action requests consent; UI readiness is not a command authorization.

machines.encoding: physical held/active/cancelled/token plus HoldFocusWatch token set
machines.invariant: Physical release and processing lifetime are distinct; a second rejected press cannot overwrite the accepted focus watch. Visible own status/menu controls preserve accepted holds including cue wait; external clicks still interrupt and focus/security surveillance remains authoritative.

machines.encoding: tap/source optionals, enabled/valid bits, hookReason, shortcutDown, captureUntil
machines.invariant: A retained port is not proof of a live permitted stream; reset lost physical gestures on recovery.

machines.encoding: AudioCapture.started/routeObserver; pipeline accepting/failed, bounded slots, serial queue
machines.invariant: Realtime tap does not call Rust/inference/AppKit; close producer before draining; report failure once.

machines.encoding: recorder identity, audioBusy, cue players, profile snapshot and delayed closures
machines.invariant: Delayed cue work rechecks recorder identity, epoch and start gate; end cue follows healthy capture drain, not cancellation.

machines.encoding: phase integer, generation, panel visibility, meter/animation timers
machines.invariant: Old timers cannot hide new UI; processing retains recording screen; overlay never steals typing focus.

machines.encoding: generation/epoch, attempted/interrupted, immutable compatibility, window/focus proofs
machines.invariant: At most one submission per session; uncertain submission is never safe to automatically retry.

machines.encoding: application/systemwide/reconfirmation lookups with permission, PID, field/window proofs
machines.invariant: Never infer exact field identity from labels/coordinates; recheck live identity after reentrant AX calls.

machines.encoding: clipboardGeneration, changeCount, saved items and restore closure
machines.invariant: Restore only still-owned clipboard contents; manual/fallback copy invalidates older timers; never log payloads.

machines.encoding: window visibility/focus, accessory/regular activation policy, exit/restart events
machines.invariant: Close hides rather than exits; focus loss revokes practice; recording never changes Dock policy; updates gate quit.

machines.encoding: State.view/running/pending(Update, Instant), RAII Operation
machines.invariant: Canonical signed/version-bound metadata only; exact ten-minute expiry clears idle offers locally; failures clear offer/notes, preserve installed version. Expired confirmation refreshes in the same owned operation before idle lease/archive bytes; only exact confirmed identity proceeds, changed offer requires reconfirmation. Operation outlives invoke; duplicate operations excluded.

machines.encoding: installing/exiting/restart_ready, InstallLease and FIFO idle barrier
machines.invariant: Install and quit cannot both win; no active work is cancelled to manufacture eligibility; lease spans installation/restart.

machines.encoding: typed UpdateView plus revision/pending/polling, revocable preparation and prepared version/revision; persistent footer projection
machines.invariant: No feed check on open/status polling; footer reflects locally validated status even with dialog closed, never treats unknown/error as up to date. Explicit Download refreshes feed before confirmation, duplicates suppressed, stale callbacks cannot reopen revoked dialogs. Prepared revision/exact version and live eligibility gate installation; changed offers require reconfirmation. Installing cannot regress to downloading; terminal result belongs to invoke.

machines.encoding: typed view, token/generation/revision, cancelling/polling/edited and optional bounded input level
machines.invariant: Clear revokes before awaiting IPC; late results cannot restore cleared text or meter; local edits beat recognition results. Meter is recording-only and never starts capture.

machines.encoding: native readiness projection; inline guide visibility and context-local shortcut receipt in main.ts
machines.invariant: Unknown checks fail closed; observation never prompts, downloads or records. Button start is not shortcut evidence; key receipt is not transcription success.

machines.encoding: held-key set and optional right-Control start timestamp
machines.invariant: Physical gesture recognition is separate from capture IPC; only isolated release saves right-Control tap; reserved chords are rejected.

machines.encoding: capturing/captureStopping/shortcutPending, generation, start promise, activationHeld, timeout
machines.invariant: Activation key is not a binding; await start before stop; stale callbacks cannot save or restore unwanted focus.

machines.encoding: per-setting pending flags, volumeEditing, previewPending and cooldown
machines.invariant: Polling must not overwrite in-flight edits; setters and preview retain separate eligibility; backend remains authoritative.

machines.encoding: single in-flight refresh promise, document visibility and permission-request bits
machines.invariant: Coalesce status refresh; never render private transcript into dashboard; visibility triggers cleanup, not a network update check.

machines.encoding: dialog open states, confirmed version snapshot, reset confirmation, focus owner
machines.invariant: Opening/initial Enter is not consent; compare confirmed live version and guards; focus restoration does not authorize effects.

machines.encoding: exhaustive readonly phase table and domain-specific phase unions
machines.invariant: Phase eligibility is necessary, never sufficient; preserve all native/token/pending guards. Shared fixtures detect frontend/Rust policy drift.

machines.encoding: owner thread commands, BINDING/TAP/HOLD/FOCUS_WATCH, CAPTURING, HUD phase
machines.invariant: Retained paused adapter: physical latch, focus watch, hook recovery and UI owner thread remain distinct.

machines.encoding: down and optional armed(time, foreground)
machines.invariant: Only same-window isolated short physical right-Control release toggles; no left-Control/AltGr/repeat substitute.

machines.encoding: CAPTURE option, lifecycle mutex, stop channel and thread join
machines.invariant: Drop WASAPI producer before draining final packets; lifecycle serializes start/stop without blocking callbacks.

machines.encoding: profile/session snapshots, PLAYING, epoch and worker acknowledgements
machines.invariant: Session profile is frozen; new preview does not overlap active capture; capture waits for cue and quiet tail.

machines.encoding: COM owner commands, captured Identity, pending Restore, generation/deadline
machines.invariant: Require HWND/PID/UIA runtime identity; partial SendInput is never safe fallback; restore only owned clipboard sequence.

machines.encoding: message-window lifetime and Drop
machines.invariant: Clipboard window stays responsive even when delivery's worker is blocked.

machines.encoding: persistent sample history, base/received/next and finish input
machines.invariant: Packet boundaries do not reset filter history; bounded retained samples; final drain preserves duration without aliasing.

machines.encoding: generation, paused/disposed/visible/reduced-motion and scheduled callback
machines.invariant: Stale scheduled work cannot restart a hidden/disposed demo; no real capture or transcription.

machines.encoding: optional async hints plus validated immutable release availability
machines.invariant: Never infer Mac Intel from missing hints, auto-download, or enable stale Windows promotion.

machines.encoding: per-button clipboard promise and status text
machines.invariant: Copy only the displayed command; never execute it. This small async UI is separate from app clipboard delivery.

machines.encoding: platform-tagged receipt, exact manifest/source hashes and clean-tree snapshot
machines.invariant: Restore only expected CLI feature changes; never hide unrelated edits or discard recovery evidence.

machines.encoding: candidate vs active availability, exact-source provenance, explicit local/draft/public mode
machines.invariant: CI, signed artifacts, deployed feed and actual runtime acceptance are separate gates; never overwrite published versions.
